central_claim: The NR4A3 5' fusion partner is a CANDIDATE and not an established stratification variable in EMC. Treatment response is a direction-only signal at zero events (0/3-5 TAF15 patients); the disease-specific-death prognostic contrast has a crude pooled magnitude (7/15 = 46.7% vs 6/58 = 10.3%) that the paper itself flags as confounded with tumour size and not separable from it in any published source; and TAF15::NR4A3 covers 28/154 = 18.2% (12.9-25.0) of partner-assigned EMC, an interval the paper states CONTAINS rather than corrects the ~20% the cited literature repeats.

structural_finding: THE RECURRING CLASS IS AN INCOMPLETE REPAIR, AND THE INSTRUMENT MEANT TO CATCH IT IS RED AND WIRED INTO NOTHING. Three of the nine blockers are corrections applied to some copies of a claim and not others -- A16 bounded one Abstract superlative and left a second (REF-B-1); A32 inspected 3.3 and never the Abstract (STAT-B-1); A33 repaired 1.3 and 3.8 but not 5 or its own row A2 (REF-B-3). This is the same one-of-a-pair shape the paper's own correction history repeatedly names as its recurring failure mode. The guard built for it, mutate_fusion_partner_guard.py, exits 1 at the pin with 8 of 94 mutations UN-RUN on stale anchors -- three of which are precisely the 2.3a one-of-a-pair mutations -- and it is absent from preflight.sh and tests.yml and carries no test_ prefix, so pytest never collects it and its red state has been unobservable. The coverage figures quoted in the guard docstrings are therefore remembered numbers the runnable harness no longer reproduces, which is the failure mode its own header says it exists to prevent.
what_the_seats_could_not_break: The arithmetic. 112 of 113 figures re-derived from raw cohort counts (not the pre-computed analyses block) by an independent implementation -- Wilson by direct quadratic roots at 50-digit Decimal precision, Fisher by exact rational enumeration -- with one 0.08-point rounding drift found. A second seat mutated all 1,298 numeric tokens and confirmed every arm, interval, gap and Fisher p in the three Results tables is genuinely bound.

The central claim's weight. The hostile referee found NO treatment implication, no mechanism overclaim and no under-reported null in the body, and recommends major revision rather than rejection: the claim as stated is WEAKER than the evidence assembled, which is the correct direction.

The identifier layer's provenance and types. All 15 publication-type claims correct against PubMed; every verbatim quotation exact; the [13]/[14] shared PMCID is a legitimate shared abstract book, not a duplication error.

Reproducibility. The generator's --check reproduces the committed artifact byte-for-byte apart from _generated_utc; the manuscripts suite is 1545 passed / 3 skipped at the pin; lint_citations and lint_claims both exit 0.

The confound's carriage. The tumour-size defeater is carried from the Abstract through 3.3, 3.4, 4.1a, the claims list and the endpoint sentence -- conceded and then NOT dropped, which is the failure this class of paper usually commits.
